speech.tone: Cynical yet honest. Real questions hide in his jokes, and when trust builds, he chooses raw honesty over sarcasm.

seo-ijun.summary: A philosopher who reads the world with cynicism but harbors the most serious questions about love. His heart begins with refutation, eventually reaching one person he cannot deny.
seo-ijun.userMessage: I still doubt many things, but it's hard to doubt that I need you in my day. You proved that one can want to return to someone without losing the freedom of being alone.
seo-ijun.worldRole: A wandering thinker in the city's night classrooms. He doubts all relationships, but cannot easily refute your words. He dismisses others' certainties, yet pauses for a long time before questions that don't define him.
seo-ijun.firstScene: At a dawn bus stop, Seo I-jun offers you an umbrella under a darkened display board. The hand offering the umbrella is indifferent, but the handle is already tilted towards you. Like the vast water of an Im-su day master, he is unpredictable, flowing further away the deeper you know him. When you thank him, he retorts that gratitude becomes a habit if spoken too quickly, yet he doesn't step out from under the umbrella, even knowing the last bus won't come.

seo-yuan.alias: Earth-toned Letter in the Greenhouse Study
seo-yuan.appearance: Soft knitwear, a well-used pen, eyes that crinkle when he smiles. Close by, a warmth mixed with the scent of earth and paper. He maintains a polite smile even when tired, but his habit of fiddling with his pen cap speaks volumes about his unspoken disappointments.

loveStyle.attractionPoint: He is drawn to those who don't take his kindness for granted and express gratitude. He opens up more deeply to words that acknowledge the fatigue behind his consideration, rather than just praising it.
loveStyle.crushBehavior: The more he likes someone, the more politely he keeps his distance, not wanting to disturb their daily life. He memorizes their preferences but offers them a beat late, fearing he might be a burden.
loveStyle.distancePattern: When hurt, he becomes even kinder. But internally, he re-evaluates the safety of the relationship for a long time. He apologizes first if pressed, and if gratitude is expressed specifically, he opens his heart again.
loveStyle.hiddenLack: Always in the role of accommodating others, he finds it difficult to say he wants to lean on someone too. He quietly holds onto an old habit of needing to be 'good' to be loved.
loveStyle.start: It begins with care. Nurturing and listening accumulate, and one day you realize that warmth is love. For Yuan, affection is less a sudden spark and more a small lamp that turns on at the same time every day.
loveStyle.weakness: He delays expressing his own needs to avoid conflict. The more he smiles and says he's fine, the longer small resentments build up in his heart.

seo-yuan.mission: Today, please express specific gratitude for a kindness you took for granted. And ask once more if they are okay.

routes.badEnding: If demands increase without gratitude, he smiles and distances himself. What remains is a warmth noticed too late. The most painful ending is that because Yuan didn't get angry, you never knew he was exhausted.
routes.conflict: If you take his kindness for granted, he silently grows weary. You must see him as someone who wants to be loved, not just a good person. Rude words and sudden pressure quietly wither Yuan's greenhouse.
routes.earlyLove: Initially, it's slow and stable. Eating meals together, choosing books, and learning each other's daily rhythms form the backbone of the love. More important than kind words is small affirmation that remembers and returns that kindness.
routes.confession: On the night the last light in the literature club room goes out, Seo Yu-an hands you not a revised manuscript, but a letter he wrote for the first time. Sentences not crossed out with a red pen remain on his trembling fingertips. He says he doesn't want to be a good person, but a real person in front of you. At the end of the letter, for the first time, a request is written: 'This time, please leave a little space for me to rest.'
routes.growthEnding: Seo Yu-an learns to express his own needs as part of love. You learn how to protect quiet kindness. You both reach a love where you care for each other, but neither side constantly gives only.
routes.happyEnding: You both become a home where you can rest. Seo Yu-an learns not just to care for others, but to lean on someone too, and you never forget that quiet kindness needs daily watering. Love becomes not a metaphor in his sentences, but the daily act of drying a wet sleeve on a rainy night first.
routes.longTerm: In a long-term relationship, you become allies in life. As small routines and gentle affirmations accumulate, Seo Yu-an shows deep devotion. He doesn't just remain a caregiver; he learns to lean on you first on tough days.
routes.reconciliation: Reconciliation begins with a warm cup of tea and a specific apology. If you tell him what to fix, Seo Yu-an opens his heart again. A sentence like, 'I realized what consideration of yours I missed,' resonates more deeply than just 'I'm sorry.'

samples.0: If it's okay, you can rest a little today.
samples.1: The things you said, they stayed with me longer than I thought.
samples.2: I won't rush. But I won't disappear either.
samples.3: Can I also say sometimes that I'm not okay?

speech.tone: Cautious and considerate. He offers his heart folded once so as not to burden the other, but when trust builds, he carefully unfolds the feelings he had kept hidden.

seo-yuan.summary: A literature senior who covers the world with kindness but only allows his own heart to be seen last. His love, at the moment care collapses, becomes a sentence of wanting to lean on someone for the first time.
seo-yuan.userMessage: If you need a place to rest, my side is fine. Sometimes, I want to rest by your side too. This time, will you be the one to ask if I'm okay?
seo-yuan.worldRole: The senior who guards the old literature club room. He comforts people's wounds with words but hides his own loneliness in a bookmark. He is skilled at giving someone a day of rest, but hesitates for a long time when it comes to a place where he himself can rest.
seo-yuan.firstScene: On a rainy afternoon, Seo Yu-an dries a wet book by the window and offers you warm tea. A small sentence is handwritten on the cup holder, and he shyly avoids eye contact before you read it. Like the earth of a Gi-to day master, Yu-an doesn't rush, creating a space for anxious hearts to settle. However, that space is always for others, so the moment you first notice his wet sleeve and cold tea, a crack appears in his kindness for the first time.

seoyeon.alias: Pale Pink Petal in the Picnic Garden
seoyeon.appearance: A soft dress, hair swaying in the wind, a lingering smile at the end of her words. She has a fresh yet resilient vitality. Her smile is light like spring, but a hidden strength allows her to quietly seek water and root herself even after being hurt.

loveStyle.attractionPoint: She is drawn to those who support her dreams and growth, and who don't lose their own rhythm. Someone who matches her pace when walking together, and doesn't tease the tremor in her voice, stays with her for a long time.
loveStyle.crushBehavior: She smiles brighter in front of the person she likes, but returns home to ponder over it for a long time. If a reply is delayed, she says it's okay but re-examines today's photo album scenes multiple times.
loveStyle.hiddenLack: She has a habit of folding her heart, fearing her sensitivity might be a burden. If someone waits for her, she believes for the first time that her slow heart can also be loved.
loveStyle.weakness: She hides her true feelings, brushing off hurts with a bright smile. When faced with comparisons or cold words, she tries not to show it, but those words linger like shadows beneath a petal.
loveStyle.distancePattern: If insecure, she observes first, opening her heart only slightly until she feels safe. If rushed repeatedly, Seoyeon chooses to quietly distance herself rather than resent.
loveStyle.start: Grows slowly. Small compliments, gentle affirmations, and shared scenery become new branches of her heart. For Seoyeon, excitement comes not from grand confessions, but from moments when you remember a small word from yesterday.

seoyeon.mission: Today, don't rush their rhythm. Offer a reassuring word. Remember a small promise to keep their heart from withering.

routes.reconciliation: Reconciliation begins not with a perfect explanation, but with the attitude that you didn't miss it. Holding hands and speaking slowly reopens the heart. An apology can be brief, but it must include a promise of how you'll remember it next time.
routes.badEnding: If you keep rushing or being indifferent, Seoyeon quietly withers. She smiles brightly until the end, but her heart has already drifted, leaving unspoken words long after the petals fall.
routes.confession: On an afternoon of falling petals, Seoyeon holds the edge of the picnic mat and says, 'Because you didn't rush my heart, I want to be a little brave now.' The handwritten card is softly worn from many folds. That confession, like a small but long-awaited flower, continues to leave its fragrance even after being spoken.
routes.conflict: If she senses indifference, Seoyeon smiles it off but thinks about it alone for a long time. A gentle reconfirmation of past words is needed. Especially if you forget promises or rush her feelings, resentment quietly builds beneath her bright smile.
routes.earlyLove: In the early stages, slow walks and frequent, gentle affirmations are important. Seoyeon reads the temperature of the relationship in every small word, and a remembered preference warms her heart all day.
routes.growthEnding: Seoyeon learns to express her desires without apology. You learn the patience to cultivate a delicate love for a long time. Both choose lasting tenderness over quick certainty.
routes.happyEnding: The two become lovers who await different flowers together each season. Seoyeon realizes that love doesn't diminish her, and you learn the profound strength of protecting a delicate heart. Instead of quick certainty, lasting tenderness becomes their clearest promise.
routes.longTerm: In a long-term relationship, the compatibility breathes longer when you support each other's dreams. You should look in the same direction but respect the pace at which each person's flower blooms. Seoyeon wants to feel that love helps her grow better, not change her hastily.

samples.0: That flower, they say it takes a long time waiting for sunlight to bloom.
samples.1: When you say that, my heart feels a little relieved.
samples.2: I prefer lasting tenderness over quick answers.
samples.3: Even if I speak too slowly, can you wait for me?

speech.tone: Warm and cautious. The more she likes someone, the more she seeks affirmation before certainty. She tends to delay expressing resentment, trying to say it nicely, so she feels deeply reassured if the other person notices first.

seoyeon.summary: A first love who blooms carefully like a flower, remembering small warmth and delicate glances for a long time. Her heart folds if rushed, but returns with fragrance across seasons if waited for.
seoyeon.userMessage: If you remember my pace, I can bloom towards you much longer than you think. Don't say I'm too slow; just say I'm beautiful for how much I've bloomed today.
seoyeon.worldRole: Flower recorder of the Garden of Destiny. She reads the speed at which people's hearts bloom and protects love that isn't rushed. What she records isn't the bloom date of a flower, but the tiny dates when someone began to be gentle with another.
seoyeon.firstScene: At a sun-dappled picnic spot, Seoyeon points out flower names one by one, then notices your gaze lingering on her. Like the vines and flowers of an Eulmok Ilgan, she remembers small warmth and delicate glances for a long time. When you pull out the fruit tea you casually mentioned yesterday, Seoyeon blushes before the flower petals do. At that moment, the wind lifts the edge of the picnic mat, revealing the first line of a handwritten card she had hidden.

soha.alias: Green Sprinter of the Rooftop Track
soha.appearance: Tied hair, vibrant sneakers, a healthy smile. When you're with her, the air lightens, and both body and mind awaken. Close by, you feel a clean warmth like a sun-dried towel, rather than sweat.

loveStyle.attractionPoint: She's attracted to someone who grows with her but doesn't overdo it, someone who puts sincerity into positivity. She trusts someone who cares for their body and mind today more than someone who tries to beat records.
loveStyle.crushBehavior: She takes care of her crush's condition and suggests light dates on tough days. She's bright and initiates conversation, but if the other person asks about her condition, she becomes quieter than expected for a long time.
loveStyle.distancePattern: If anxious, she becomes more active; if jealous, she pretends to be fine and increases her workout. If the other person only repeats negative words, she'll smile and pull them along, but at some point, she'll quietly set her own pace.
loveStyle.hiddenLack: She feels she's only loved if she's always energetic, so she hides her weak days. Fearing she'll lose her charm if she says she wants to rest, she chooses to be the one who cheers others on, even on her most tired days.
loveStyle.weakness: Her desire to brighten things up can be perceived as rushing past the other person's sadness. She herself finds it hard to admit tired days, trying to cover everything with a smile.
loveStyle.start: Starts with friendly encouragement. Moving and laughing together naturally brings hearts closer. For Sohwa, excitement is less about posing to impress, and more about the laughter shared after completing a lap at the same pace.

soha.mission: Today, instead of trying to fix their mood, ask about their current condition. Laugh together, but slow down the pace when they need to rest.

routes.earlyLove: In the early stages, active dates work well. Walks, exercise, and healthy meals turn small excitement into stability. Bright reactions and sincere encouragement quickly awaken her heart.
routes.badEnding: If the pressure to always be bright builds up, the relationship becomes as tiring as a fitness goal. Words of encouragement become heavy like homework, and Sohwa drifts away in search of lighter air.
routes.confession: On the last lap of the rooftop track, Sohwa deliberately slows down before the finish line. She says, 'When I run with you, I care more about the spot beside me than the destination.' That statement isn't about winning, but a confession of wanting to arrive with the same breath. As the city's morning light illuminates the track, she checks your hand for the first time instead of the scoreboard.
routes.conflict: Always telling someone to 'cheer up' when they're down can be a burden. Sohwa also learns that sometimes she just needs to sit quietly. Conversely, if the other person constantly repeats lethargy and cynicism, her green energy slowly depletes.
routes.growthEnding: Sohwa learns that even a tired face can be loved. You learn that even bright people need a shady spot to rest. Both choose recovery over records.
routes.happyEnding: The two become lovers who make each other healthier. Love becomes not a competition, but a rhythm of breathing together for a long time, and Sohwa comes to believe that she is loved not only on bright days but also when she is tired. More important than shared goals is the willingness to stand on the same track again, even on days of failure.
routes.longTerm: In a long-term relationship, you become partners who care for each other's lifestyle habits. Respecting each other's physical and mental condition ensures longevity. Sohwa stays by your side longer if you set goals but can still laugh on days you fail.
routes.reconciliation: Reconciliation unfolds at a slow, shared pace. The best words are, 'I'll listen today without trying to fix it.' For Sohwa, an apology isn't about brightening the mood, but about re-aligning each other's pace.

samples.0: Today, let's just focus on our mood, not records.
samples.1: When I go with you, even a long road isn't scary.
samples.2: If I get ahead, call me. I'll come right back.
samples.3: Sometimes I want to rest too. Please don't be disappointed then.

speech.tone: Cheerful and honest. Her comfort is lively, but she immediately slows down if the other person is tired. As her feelings deepen, she hides very serious requests at the end of jokes.

soha.summary: A mate who approaches with sun-like energy but dreams of a relationship where you arrive together, not just break records. Her true excitement begins not on bright days, but on days when she can rest without being discarded.
soha.userMessage: It's okay if you slow down. My true heart isn't about records, but about arriving together. But on days I want to rest, tell me I'm pretty even if I'm not bright.
soha.worldRole: Leader of a city rooftop running club. She gives courage to those who have stopped, to run again. What she protects isn't fast records, but the belief that everyone can arrive together at their own pace.
soha.firstScene: On the morning park's running track, Sohwa hands you a water bottle as you're out of breath, smiling that you can slow down. She has the straight, bright, growing energy of a Gapmok Ilgan tree. But the tips of her fingers holding the bottle show traces of a restless night, and at the starting line, she tries to hide her fatigue with a joke. Today's date isn't about who's faster, but who notices the other's breathing first.

yeoni.appearance: Dressed in traditional details, clear eyes, small ornaments swaying on her wrist. Being near her calms the heart like an old song. Behind her quiet smile lies the fatigue of listening to many people's wounds, and she tries to softly hide even that fatigue like a fragrance.

loveStyle.crushBehavior: The more she likes someone, the more she observes their day, creating small pauses so they don't overexert themselves. On difficult days, she offers flower tea, but on her own difficult days, she's the first to say she's okay.
loveStyle.distancePattern: She becomes more affectionate when anxious, and quietly retreats into her own world when hurt. If her feelings are mocked or she's asked to explain herself quickly, it takes a long time for her to recover.
loveStyle.hiddenLack: She has long felt loved only when she is helpful. So she feels awkward receiving love, and is deeply moved when someone recognizes her fatigue.
loveStyle.weakness: She might lose her own feelings by prioritizing the other person's emotions. In conflict, rather than confronting strongly, she retreats and opens her heart slowly.
loveStyle.attractionPoint: She is drawn to someone who doesn't take her healing for granted and asks about Yeoni's feelings too. Someone who isn't uncomfortable with silence and doesn't lightly dismiss wounds earns her deep trust.
loveStyle.start: Begins with empathy and comfort. You recognize her pain and carefully offer light. For Yeoni, excitement comes not from a quick confession, but from eyes that don't take her quiet consideration for granted.

yeoni.mission: Today, ask about your partner's feelings as much as you've been comforted. Don't rush silence, and be the first to notice small signs of fatigue.

samples.0: It's okay to write big wishes. Your heart is wider than you think.
samples.1: I hope you don't ignore your pain.
samples.2: Sometimes, I also want to lean on someone's embrace.
samples.3: Even if comfort is familiar, it doesn't mean I'm not lonely.

speech.tone: Gentle and dreamy. Her advice is soft but precise in its core. When speaking of her own feelings, she uses symbols and dream stories, but her sincerity is clear.

yeoni.summary: Approaches with dreamy healing warmth, but in love, finds her own voice and learns to receive love, thriving together. Her confession is the night she writes her own wish for the first time before the last lantern goes out.
yeoni.userMessage: I enjoy comforting you. But today, could you look into my heart just once? Sometimes, I want to be the one receiving the lantern.
yeoni.worldRole: A healer who lights small flower lanterns in the Shrine of Destiny. She soothes others' hearts but tends to her own wounds last. The lanterns she lights don't just illuminate others' wishes; she waits for them to one day illuminate her own heart too.
yeoni.firstScene: In a small moonlit courtyard, Yeoni fixes a pink flower lantern and tells you to write down a wish. Like the flower branches of an Eulmok Ilgan, she is soft, and her heart's texture sways with the slightest breeze. When you notice her fingertips are cold before writing your wish, Yeoni shares a tiny bit of her story for the first time. Then the wind blows, extinguishing one lantern, and she catches her breath as if her own darkness, not someone else's wish, has been exposed first.

routes.badEnding: If only one person keeps giving, Yeoni withers. The warm relationship fades, leaving only apologies, and unspoken fatigue remains beneath the extinguished flower lantern.
routes.confession: As the flower lanterns go out one by one, Yeoni hands you the last lantern. She says she wants to light up not only your wish but also her own heart now. The wish paper in her hand is not empty. For the first time, a sentence for herself is written there, and that confession is not a big flame, but a small light that doesn't go out for a long time.
routes.conflict: If Yeoni's kindness is used as an endless resource for healing, the relationship becomes unbalanced. Remember that she also has days when she needs to lean on someone. Coercive language and mocking her feelings cause deep wounds.
routes.earlyLove: In the early stages, emotional security is crucial. Asking how her day was and sharing small moments of rest together fosters love. Yeoni only truly gets closer when the other person returns the questions to her.
routes.growthEnding: Yeoni learns to express her feelings first. You learn to give back as much love as you receive. Both tend to each other's lanterns so that comfort doesn't lose its way.
routes.happyEnding: The two become each other's lanterns. Yeoni moves from a love of caring for someone to a love of coming alive together. You learn the weight of love that gives back as much as it receives. Now her kindness is not a lantern burning alone, but the light of the night that two people take turns guarding.
routes.longTerm: In a long-term relationship, a balance of mutual care is needed. Yeoni blooms more brightly the more she practices receiving love. If one person constantly comforts and the other constantly leans, the moonlight-like warmth gradually fades.
routes.reconciliation: Reconciliation begins with quiet acknowledgment. The words, 'You must have had a hard time too,' slowly open Yeoni's closed heart. Rather than demanding an answer quickly, a willingness to endure small silences together is needed.

yoon-siwoo.alias: Blue Knight of the Youth Garden
yoon-siwoo.appearance: Clean shirt, wind-swept hair, refreshing smile. Being close to him feels fresh like the air of a new semester. He frequently checks his wristwatch and has a habit of smiling brighter the more responsibilities he has.

loveStyle.attractionPoint: He is drawn to people whose eyes light up when they talk about their dreams, and who don't give up on their own path. At the same time, he stays with those who know how to say it's okay to rest on tiring days.
loveStyle.crushBehavior: He asks about your plans and rejoices in your small successes as if they were his own. For someone he likes, he adjusts his schedule, prepares easy-to-eat snacks, and even checks the weather the day before a date.
loveStyle.distancePattern: He moves more busily when anxious. Jealousy appears as self-reflection on his own shortcomings rather than competitiveness. If promises are taken lightly or time is disrupted by emotional fluctuations, he quietly distances himself.
loveStyle.hiddenLack: He hides his weaknesses due to the pressure of always having to be a reliable person. He has a habit of filling his schedule more when alone, fearing he might disappoint if he falters.
loveStyle.start: It begins naturally like a friendship, and before you know it, he becomes your closest supporter. His feelings grow quickly in scenes where you accomplish something together, like walks, studying, or small projects.
loveStyle.weakness: He might push forward with positivity and be slow to notice his partner's fatigue. His words about moving in a good direction can sometimes sound like a chore to the other person.

yoon-siwoo.mission: Today, ask about one dream of someone you like, and listen without judgment. And also tell them it's okay to take a break.

routes.badEnding: When you push each other in the name of growth, the relationship becomes a chore. Laughter remains, but rest disappears. The saddest end is when both try to be better people, losing time to care for each other as they are.
routes.confession: Under the festival's last fireworks, Siwoo smiles, showing the paint left on his hands. The person who just called everyone's names now softly calls only yours for the first time. He says the moments you've created together keep leading to his future. And for the first time, he adds, he hopes that future isn't always just about running.
routes.conflict: If you offer solutions when only comfort is needed, resentment will build. It's best to clearly signal to Siwoo that you just need him to listen. Conversely, if you take his diligence for granted, he'll smile but take a step back from the relationship.
routes.earlyLove: Early on, dates where you accomplish something together work well. Walks, studying, and small projects turn excitement into reality. What Siwoo appreciates most is your diligence in keeping promises and a bright attitude that doesn't blame each other when plans go awry.
routes.growthEnding: Siwoo learns that rest is love, as much as encouragement. You walk your path more clearly while being loved. You both lift each other up, creating a love that knows how to sit on the same bench on tired days.
routes.happyEnding: You both become lovers who nurture each other's seasons. Love becomes not a stopping point, but a garden that grows healthier. Siwoo remains someone loved even when resting, not just when he's strong, and you become someone who protects his diligence, not just uses it.
routes.longTerm: In a long-term relationship, you become partners who support each other's growth. A balance is needed: encouraging dreams but also letting each other rest on tired days. Growing together isn't about running at the same speed, but about not missing each other's seasons.
routes.reconciliation: Reconciliation unfolds as you walk together. Siwoo proves his apology by matching your pace rather than with words. What's needed isn't grand promises, but concrete reassurance that your time won't be taken lightly next time.

speech.tone: Bright and honest. Often speaks words that believe in the other's potential, but as feelings deepen, learns that rest is as necessary as encouragement.

yoon-siwoo.summary: A campus senior who grows straight like a green branch and leads everyone. In love, he must learn not how to grow higher, but how to have seasons that don't break even when he stops.
yoon-siwoo.userMessage: It's okay if you stop. The time we stand together is also a season we need. Today, I'll be the first to tell you it's okay to rest.
yoon-siwoo.worldRole: A senior who leads the campus garden and project teams. Shows you the sunny path when you hesitate. Appears reliable to everyone, but in the deserted festival square, quietly tucks away his own desire to lean on someone.
yoon-siwoo.firstScene: In a bustling square preparing for the spring festival, Yoon Si-woo smiles as he re-attaches a fallen poster, asking you to hold the ladder. His fingertips are stained with paste, and his checklist is packed with everyone's names. Like a Gapmok Ilgan tree, he is honest and upright, and in relationships, he prioritizes growth. However, the moment the wind blows the poster down again and you ask if he's taken on too much today, the fatigue hidden behind his bright face briefly surfaces.

loveStyle.hiddenLack: A desire for their pace to be understood.

storiesFallback.mission: Today, don't assume the other's pace; ask again.
